topic: Familiarization with various parts of aircraft and different arrangement of components as seen on various aircraft in station.
syllabus_extract: Familiarization with various parts of aircraft and different arrangement of components as seen on various aircraft in station.
specific_objectives: 15.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain aircraft structure, various structural elements and their details.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Identification of primary and secondary structural elements on a cutaway model; Safety: Handle models with care to avoid damage; Supervision: Instructor verifies correct identification of fuselage, wings, and tail surfaces.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the fuselage?
Name two types of wings used in modern aircraft.
Why is the empennage critical for flight stability?

development.content:
Fuselage structure and types
Wing configuration and components
Empennage assembly details
Landing gear arrangement
Power plant location

Comparison of component layouts
Structural element identification
Material usage in structures
Component arrangement variations
Station-specific configurations

Review of structural elements
Identification of key stations
Function of major components
Variations across aircraft types
Safety implications of structure

summary_questions: Explain the difference between monocoque and semi-monocoque structures.
How does the arrangement of landing gear affect ground handling?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing the structural layout of the aircraft currently in station with one previously studied, focusing on component arrangement.

pft_rows.syllabus: Overall consideration of aircraft loading action. Symmetric flight loads, symmetric maneuvers
